concept.title: The Trader's Signal Overload
concept.target_icp: Forex and crypto traders aged 25-45 following multiple signal channels
concept.hook: Trader staring at screen with contradictory buy/sell signals
concept.story: Trader overwhelmed by noise discovers CrowdWisdom structured clarity

scenes.visuals: Trader in a dim room, multiple monitors flashing conflicting red/green buy/sell signals from various channels
scenes.narration: Traders drown in conflicting signals from every direction.
scenes.sound: Overlapping urgent voice alerts from different channels

scenes.visuals: Close-up of trader's eyes darting between screens, hand rubbing temples
scenes.sound: Rapid heartbeat sound mixed with the alerts
scenes.music: Continues tense beats, slightly more dissonant

scenes.visuals: Trader clicks open CrowdWisdom app; screen transitions to clean blue interface
scenes.sound: A soft click, then the alerts fade

scenes.visuals: Close-up of CrowdWisdom interface showing a single consensus line with rising confidence meter
scenes.narration: One clear signal emerges from the crowd.
scenes.sound: Alerts replaced by calm ambient tone

scenes.visuals: Trader leans back, smiling, pointing at the screen
CrowdWisdom logo and tagline: 'Signal clarity from the crowd'
CTA button: 'See the consensus' pulses gently

concept.narration: When every channel shouts a different direction, clarity is lost. CrowdWisdom brings the crowd to one voice, turning confusion into conviction
concept.visual_direction: Dark, cluttered desk with multiple monitors showing red/green arrows; shift to clean, blue-toned interface with single consensus line
concept.sound_direction: Start with overlapping urgent voice alerts, fade to calm ambient tone as clarity emerges
concept.music_direction: Tense, staccato electronic beats transitioning to steady, hopeful synth pad
evidence: ad insight: traders follow signal channels
